Provide guidance, feedback, and inspiration to direct reports, fostering a high-performing and creatively ambitious marketing team. Monitor campaign performance through timely reports and recommend changes based on data insights. Extensive experience in digital marketing, content marketing, and marketing technology. Adaptability and experience working with differing market dynamics to guide marketers and steer campaign strategy. Oversight of marketing campaign delivery in line with business objectives, timelines, and budgets. Management of a cross-functional marketing team. Building strong awareness, consideration, and demand for LIONS Riyadh across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, and priority international markets. Driving qualified registrations, ticket sales, and attendance from priority audience segments. Ensuring all campaigns reflect the LIONS brand, tone, and creative standards. Delivering strong digital engagement, conversion, and return on marketing investment. Building an active year-round community around the LIONS Riyadh brand via content marketing. Monitor daily and sprint-level engineering delivery, timelines, dependencies, and blockers. Independently validate completed work through staging, API testing, QA evidence, PR/code review, and production behavior. Own release-readiness and production deployment governance. 0e95d06a924dbfe9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الملتزم الطبية عن فني أشعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تجهيز معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية، وإعداد المرضى، وتشغيل الأجهزة لاستخراج الصور الشعاعية وطباعتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد أجهزة التصوير بالأشعة السينية بشكل دوري لضمان جاهزيتها. تأمين ومراقبة مستلزمات التصوير الضرورية مثل الأفلام والأدوية. اتخاذ إجراءات الوقاية الشخصية اللازمة لحماية النفس والمرضى. تنظيم مواعيد المرضى لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. مرافقة المرضى إلى غرفة التصوير بالأشعة وتحديد أجزاء الجسم المراد تصويرها. تحديد طبيعة الصورة الشعاعية ومواصفات الأشعة المطلوبة بناءً على طلب الطبيب المعالج. تثبيت ألواح من الرصاص لحماية الأجزاء الجسدية التي يجب ألا تتعرض للأشعة. توجيه وضبط أجهزة التصوير واختيار مدة وشدة التعرض للأشعة لالتقاط الصور الشعاعية. إظهار وتثبيت الصور الشعاعية، وتثبيت المعلومات الأساسية عليها، وتقديمها لطبيب أخصائي الأشعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التصوير بالأشعة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة معدات التصوير بالأشعة السينية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الإشعاع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل طبية متخصصة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى والعمل ضمن فريق طبي متكامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الملتزم الطبية.

This full-time role involves taking ownership of data on behalf of the business, ensuring data stewardship aligns with the enterprise data management asset model, and leading data initiatives at the divisional level. Key Responsibilities Represent the business division's voice in the executive governance committee. Ensure data stewardship adheres to the enterprise data management asset model. Lead data initiatives at the divisional level and represent the bank's business divisions. Understand business division strategies and contribute to bank-wide data strategies, including enterprise data as assets and information management strategies. Act as a liaison between business areas and other data management sections. Ensure effective implementation of policies and standards for data sources related to the assigned division. Operational Duties Assist in the development and execution of Data Stewardship policies, procedures, and controls for all data sources. Perform day-to-day activities, ensuring work processes are implemented as designed and comply with established policies, processes, and procedures. Manage data stewardship at the divisional level, serving as a single point of contact for business data within that division. Liaise with business areas to ensure their interests and requirements regarding data are considered. Represent the assigned business area for data-related matters, such as data requirements and provisions. Represent business units in the Enterprise Data Governance Committee. Promote standards and a consistent view of business data. Knowledge Transfer and Communication Educate business units on the importance of data and information in driving business outcomes. Supervise relationships with data consumers. Direct and guide subordinates on their roles as Enterprise Data Stewards at all levels. Leadership and Team Management Manage the effective achievement of Enterprise Data Steward Unit objectives. Lead the Enterprise Data Steward Unit by setting individual objectives, recruiting qualified staff, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals to maximize subordinate and division performance. 0e11b9a7745d995b.description: About the Role moomoo is seeking a Strategic Partnerships & Influencer Lead to develop and manage the company's partnership and creator growth strategy in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The successful candidate will identify key partners, creators, and communities that influence Saudi investors, build local relationships, and structure collaborations to drive measurable business growth. As an early member of the Saudi team, this position offers significant ownership in shaping local influencer and partnership strategies, with opportunities to build and lead a team as the business expands. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement local partnership strategies to enhance brand awareness, customer acquisition, Assets Under Management (AUM), and revenue. Map the Saudi influencer, financial, media, and business ecosystem to identify high-potential opportunities and new growth areas based on local market insights. Source and cultivate relationships with financial institutions, media, fintechs, consumer platforms, major brands, and other strategic partners, managing the full partnership cycle from outreach to performance review. Develop creative cooperation models, including co-marketing, educational initiatives, referral programs, events, sponsorships, and integrated campaigns. Identify and build relationships with leading finance, investing, business, and relevant mainstream creators, developing a diverse influencer portfolio across various audience segments and content formats. Negotiate sustainable long-term, performance-based, or exclusive cooperation models with creators, collaborating with them to develop content aligned with audience needs and business objectives. Manage the commercial performance of influencer and partnership channels, evaluating opportunities based on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), customer quality, AUM, trading activity, revenue, and strategic value. Track performance, optimize partnerships, and prioritize opportunities that demonstrate the strongest business impact. Develop a comprehensive understanding of how Saudi investors discover, evaluate, and trust financial platforms, building relationships across the local financial and business ecosystem. Monitor competitors, creators, platforms, and emerging opportunities, translating these insights into local growth strategies. Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, Product, Compliance, Legal, Brand, and Data teams to execute initiatives, coordinating internal resources, timelines, and requirements for partnership launches. Ensure all influencer and partnership activities comply with local regulatory and internal requirements. Team Leadership and Development Build and lead the Saudi Partnerships & Influencer team as the market scales. Establish team priorities, targets, and execution standards to ensure strong delivery against business goals. Coach and develop team members in prospecting, relationship management, negotiation, and commercial execution. Establish scalable processes and local playbooks for sourcing, evaluating, and managing partnerships and influencers. Cultivate a commercially driven team culture with a high sense of ownership, contributing to moomoo’s broader Saudi growth strategy. Required Qualifications Proven ability to source, negotiate, and finalize significant commercial partnerships. Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or developing Business Development, Partnership, or Key Opinion Leader (KOL) teams, with the capacity to drive both individual and team performance. Strong understanding of the Saudi business, creator, media, and digital ecosystem. Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, effective with creators, founders, and senior decision-makers. Strong commercial judgment and analytical capabilities, including an understanding of CAC, AUM, revenue, and Return on Investment (ROI). Ability to transition from strategic planning to hands-on execution in a dynamic, early-stage market. Strong cross-functional coordination and project management skills.

0e1614e2e6950657.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a PTW Coordinator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for managing and coordinating the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system at the project site. The role ensures that all high-risk activities are properly authorized, controlled, and executed in compliance with project HSE procedures and client requirements. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and administer the site Permit-to-Work system for all applicable activities. Review PTW applications for completeness and ensure required approvals are obtained before work commences. Coordinate permits for various high-risk activities including electrical work, hot work, excavation, confined space entry, work at height, lifting operations, and isolation/LOTO procedures. Verify that risk assessments, method statements, Job Safety Analyses (JSA)/Job Hazard Analyses (JHA), and other supporting documents are attached to permits. Ensure appropriate isolations, barricading, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), and control measures are in place prior to permit issuance. Liaise with Permit Issuers, Permit Receivers, EHS, Construction, and Operations teams. Maintain an up-to-date PTW register and track permit status, validity, suspension, and closure. Conduct regular site checks to verify compliance with approved permits and their conditions. Ensure permits are properly suspended, extended, or closed as required. Prevent unauthorized work and immediately escalate any PTW violations or unsafe conditions. Conduct PTW awareness and refresher briefings for relevant site personnel. Maintain PTW records for audits and management reporting. Support PTW audits and recommend improvements to enhance the permit system. Ensure compliance with company, client, and Saudi regulatory HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

0e2be707b1096103.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الضوء الحديث للسباكة والكهرباء عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية، من إعداد مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات إلى إعداد التقارير المالية الدورية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دقيق. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإجراءاتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المستندات المالية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير والقيود المحاسبية. القدرة على تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات في المجال. مهارات جيدة في التواصل لإعداد التقارير وحفظها. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات اليومية للمؤسسة. تقديم الطلبات الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن. للمهتمين، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة الضوء الحديث للسباكة والكهرباء.

0eed583b3d69bd99.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance projects and develop potential. The company's values guide its consultancy approach and define the professionals sought to join its teams. This role is part of a major program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on a mixed-use development that includes sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. Mace serves as a delivery partner, requiring experienced professionals to lead integrated teams throughout the project phases. Role Summary As the Director of Systems & Rolling Stock, you will provide technical vision, engineering leadership, and governance for a fully automated (GoA4) driverless rail system. Operating client-side within a developer-led environment, you will bridge the gap between master planning and core rail systems. This full-time position in Riyadh requires over 10 years of experience. You will be responsible for the technical integrity of the system, driving decisions from concept and design management to procurement and integration. A key part of this role involves managing technical consultants, ensuring compliance with internal governance frameworks, and managing alignment with interfacing developers. Key Responsibilities Serve as the technical authority for all railway sub-systems, including Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4) signaling (CBTC), rolling stock, power supply/traction, telecommunications, SCADA, and depot equipment. Lead the integration of rail infrastructure into master-planned developer sectors, ensuring civil, structural, and architectural interfaces meet the system's spatial and functional needs. Ensure the system utilizes modern, reliable automated rail technologies optimized for Saudi Arabia's environmental conditions. Act as the primary client interface for international engineering consultants, Project Management Officers (PMOs), and specialized shadow operators, holding partners accountable for deliverables, quality, and timelines. Establish and execute technical review gateways, safety assurance protocols (RAMS), and configuration control boards, ensuring all systems engineering processes comply with international standards and local regulations. Identify technical risks early and implement mitigation strategies, conducting value engineering exercises to optimize capital expenditure without compromising safety, capacity, or performance. Coordinate with internal and external real estate development teams to align the rail system's alignment, station footprints, and utility corridors with adjacent mixed-use developments.
